title: edges
body:
## edges

Extracts every edge of every cell as a line cell, giving a wireframe polydata of the whole mesh, including interior edges of volume cells. Each shared edge appears once and receives the cell data of the lowest-numbered cell using it. Use it to show or export mesh structure or to measure edge lengths; use featureEdges for only boundary or sharp edges of a surface, and run surface first if only the outer skin's edges are wanted.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- On volume meshes the output holds all interior edges and can be several times larger than the input; ParaView warns about memory for structured inputs.

Native constructor: `ExtractEdges`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Extract Edges filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "edges",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
